assets.prompt: Create one full-body skiing pose of the same player character as the reference for a hand-painted 2D side-scrolling downhill game. Preserve the Naiwa identity: small rounded head, pear-shaped golden yellow body, pale cream belly, green irises, long legs, broad dark gray-brown hands, flat three-toed feet and short tail. Side view facing right in a balanced crouched skiing pose on one ochre board. Matte gouache-like 2D hand-painted shading, cool blue-violet shadows, no 3D/CGI, no text, no logo, genuine transparent background.
